title: Photonic MAC (component models)
description: Compact encoder → DAC → nonlinear MZM → split → ideal signed weight transmissions → independent photodetectors → current subtraction. External laser preserves explicit power/noise wiring. x∈[0,1], w∈[−1,1] use dimensionless values on voltage ports. Outputs are time samples, not an automatic vector sum; integrate over the intended symbol duration. Expand using the component-chain example to inspect every stage.

params.name: bias_rad
params.description: Differential bias phase; transfer uses bias_rad / 2.

params.name: loss_dB
params.description: Deterministic insertion loss; remains active with noise off.

params.name: v_min
params.description: Converter lower endpoint. Must be less than v_max.

params.name: clip
params.description: False rejects out-of-range commands; true explicitly clips to converter rails.

params.name: ratio
params.description: Fraction of incident power in upper arm.

params.name: responsivity
params.description: Photocurrent per watt of incident optical power.

params.name: dark_enabled
params.description: Adds deterministic dark current even when global noise is off.

params.name: dark_current_A
params.description: Mean dark current, included in shot-noise variance when enabled.

params.name: shot_enabled
params.description: Global noise AND this switch enable white Gaussian shot noise, variance 2 q Imean fs/2.

params.name: seed
params.description: Block seed offset. Combined with run seed and instance ID; integer 0..2^32-1.
